title: Minesweeper
description: Minesweeper with safe first reveals, controller and touch controls, flags, three difficulties, and saved progress

screens.name: HELP
screens.title: Minesweeper controls
items: Tilt the controller to move the outlined cell. Hold a tilt to repeat. Turn the knob to choose Reveal, Flag or Open around, then press to apply that action.
Tap a board cell to apply the selected mode. The mode button cycles actions. Reveal and Flag buttons always apply their named action to the outlined cell.
The first revealed cell and its neighbors contain no mines. Empty areas open automatically. A number counts mines in its eight surrounding cells.
Flag suspected mines, then unflag them if needed. Flagged cells cannot be revealed. Flags are limited to the board's mine count. Clear every safe cell to win.
Open around applies to a revealed number when its neighboring flag count matches the number. It reveals the remaining neighbors. Incorrect flags can cause a mine hit.
The timer starts on the first reveal and counts active play only. Each difficulty keeps its own wins and best completion time. Difficulty changes apply to new games.
BACK or Pause returns to the menu and saves. Calls, popups, leaving the app and vehicle movement pause play. Resume explicitly when ready. Parked only is on by default.

screens.name: NEW_GAME
screens.title: Start a new game?
items: Your current saved game will be replaced. Your wins and best times are kept.
